description: Agent protocol (L3, crate fgos-agent-protocol): one pure state machine per CLI x launch mode. It reads what the agent shows and names what happened; it never opens a tab, picks a model, changes a timeout or decides a retry. It does not build argv: argv comes from the executor configuration through resolveExecutorCommand (src/runner/dispatch/transport.mjs) and is written into the envelope (owner decision 2026-10-16).

io.description: Port the supervisor wires to the adapter: terminal-control by key (terminal, 6.3). The direct mode reads no port: its adapter is handed the exit and the capture tail.

screen.output: string, the whole visible screen right now

output.state: string or null (idle, working, blocked, done)
output.matchedRule: boolean, a screen rule vouched for the verdict
output.promptText: string, the composer text the rule saw

inspect.meaning: the multiplexer's own agent detection for the pane (terminal-control inspect with detail); never a guess of the supervisor

clock.output: now_ms (monotonic) and pause(ms); every wait of an adapter goes through them so a vector can run on a virtual clock

results.ready: terminal: the CLI shows an empty prompt and can take the brief

blocked.meaning: the CLI waits for something only a person can do

results.delivered: terminal: the brief is confirmed submitted (not merely visible)
results.delivery-unknown: terminal: could not confirm; never resend blind

completed.meaning: the agent finished and its result file exists

results.needs-human: the agent asked a question in its result or output that only a person can answer

exited.meaning: the agent process exited without a result file

directAdapter.inputs: envelope.launch (briefPath, outboxDir, capture paths), the agent exit reported by gate-exit, and the capture tail
decides: activity source for idle: growth of the stdout capture (any new text, a JSON event line included)
completion: agent exited and outbox/result-<N>.json exists -> completed; exited without it -> exited(code) unless a blocked/needs-human pattern was read
named blocked results from known output patterns (login prompt, trust dialog, usage limit)

matrix.unknownCli: direct: an unknown CLI gets the generic adapter (exit and outbox only, no output patterns); terminal: an envelope naming a CLI without a terminal adapter is refused before launch (agent-protocol-unsupported)

vectors: fixtures per cell live under packages/agent-protocol/contracts/fixtures/<mode>/<cli>/vectors.json (direct and terminal cells exist; terminal vectors replay recorded screens on a virtual clock)
